thermal_assumptions.limitation: Resistance/heat estimate only; excludes pad/current crowding, plated barrel, solder/contact resistance, branch current division, copper temperature coefficient and heat transfer.

plane_polygon_limits: Native cached filled paths decoded at 0.1mil units; arc tessellation2degrees; point-in-filled-polygon test at via centers ONLY, not full-plane continuity/impedance proof.

ground_connectivity.limitation: Pad connections use bounding boxes; native cached pour contours assumed valid. Each plane has one outer contour with holes; this is complementary evidence, not regenerated native DRC or dielectric safety validation.

return_plane_projection_limit: 0.25mm midpoint sampling at trace CENTER; isolated antipads and pad breakout edges are counted. Flagged length is not an SI fail criterion; review geometry before judging. Does not model return current spread, stitching via inductance or differential field coupling.
